Title: Azure CycleCloud 7 will be retired on 30 September 2023

Body.Content:
Azure CycleCloud now provides CycleCloud 8 with new features and removal of Python 2.7 support in clusters. As Python 2.7 reached end-of-life in 2020, CycleCloud 7 will be retired on 30 September 2023. Please transition to using CycleCloud 8 by that date. 

Required Action 

To avoid disruptions to your workflow and minimize security vulnerabilities, follow these steps to transition using CycleCloud 8 before 30 September 2023.  After that, we’ll stop supporting CycleCloud 7 and no additional security patches or bug fixes will be released. Since CycleCloud is an installed product, you may continue to use their installations past this date at your own risk.

Help and Support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
